project.projectName: 宿舍纪念社区 - 桌面端
project.designRead: Dorm memorial community / Chinese college students / warm editorial scrapbook / medium density / avoid torn-paper random rotation

root.title: 宿舍纪念社区 - 桌面端

pages.title: 首页
pages.visualNorthStar: Greet members with a warm dorm hero, 'on this day' snippet, quick composer, and a readable feed of recent memories.
continuityAnchors: warm white surface and terracotta primary

pages.title: 照片墙
pages.visualNorthStar: A masonry-led media gallery with filter bar and video covers, where media remains the primary decoration.
continuityAnchors: warm white surface and terracotta primary

pages.title: 发布
pages.visualNorthStar: Centered, focused editor with text area, media upload list and progress, and restrained more-settings panel.
continuityAnchors: warm white surface and terracotta primary

pages.title: 论坛
pages.visualNorthStar: Board cards followed by a clear thread list with title, excerpt, author, reply count and last activity.
continuityAnchors: warm white surface and terracotta primary

pages.title: 主题详情
pages.visualNorthStar: Thread header with title and metadata, followed by continuous reply floors with restrained quoted left borders.
continuityAnchors: warm white surface and terracotta primary

pages.title: 消息
pages.visualNorthStar: Dual-pane chat layout: conversation list on the left, message history and composer on the right.
continuityAnchors: warm white surface and terracotta primary

pages.title: 个人留言
pages.visualNorthStar: Profile header with avatar and memorial info, followed by a single-column guestbook message stream.
continuityAnchors: warm white surface and terracotta primary
